first_step_test: The diagonal spine and complete lower coil fix the pin angle and leave a clear start for its open arm.

source.notes: First sheet rejected privately because the open bend closed into a coil. Second six-panel generated raster sheet approved after full and saved-crop review.

final_elements.name: wire spine and coil
final_elements.description: One long diagonal spine attached to one complete round lower coil.

final_elements.name: open pointed arm
final_elements.description: One straight pointed arm rises from the coil and stays open.

final_elements.name: clasp housing
final_elements.description: One folded metal clasp attached to the top of the spine.

final_elements.name: two clasp glints and one coil glint
final_elements.description: Two short parallel glints on the clasp and one small coil glint.

final_elements.name: broken ground shadow
final_elements.description: One soft broken horizontal shadow under the coil.

frames.visible_job: One diagonal spine ends in a complete lower coil.
frames.instruction: Draw a long diagonal spine down-right and loop its lower end into one complete round coil.

frames.visible_job: One pointed arm rises from the coil.
frames.instruction: From the coil, pull a straight slim arm upward and taper it to a point, leaving a wide gap to the spine top.

frames.visible_job: One hook clasp attaches to the top spine end.
frames.instruction: At the top end of the spine, draw a folded hook clasp with its opening facing the pointed arm.

frames.visible_job: Two clasp glints and one coil glint appear.
frames.instruction: Add two short parallel glints inside the clasp and one tiny curved glint inside the coil.
adds: two clasp glints and one coil glint
introduces: two clasp glints and one coil glint

frames.visible_job: A broken shadow appears under the coil.
frames.instruction: Shade a broken horizontal shadow below the pin, darkest under the coil.

final_step.visible_job: Graphite shading strengthens existing forms without new contours.
final_step.instruction: Strengthen the established spine, arm, coil, and clasp with 2B graphite, leaving the existing glints pale and deepening the existing ground shadow.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop has a complete round coil connected to a long diagonal spine at the final anchors; the open space reserves the pin arm.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: I compared the full second sheet and six saved crops in order. The spine and coil anchors, rising point, folded clasp, three glints, and ground shadow persist. No guides or moved structural lines appear. The last crop only deepens established graphite.
